fields.en: The headland and the tombolo that joins it to the rest of the land. The pale line is the beach path.
fields.hr: Rt i prevlaka koja ga spaja s ostatkom zemlje. Svijetla crta je put po žalu.

fields.hr: ZELENO = raste ovdje i ostaje · NARANČASTO = uklanja se · MASLINASTI OKVIR = sadi se

fields.en: The site lies in Bačina uvala, below the Čelinjak ridge on the island of Ugljan, twenty minutes by ferry from Zadar. Cadastral parcels 2448/6, 2448/14, 2448/13 and 2449/1, measured at 7,02 hectares with 1,11 km of perimeter.
fields.hr: Teren leži u Bačinoj uvali, ispod grebena Čelinjak na otoku Ugljanu, dvadeset minuta trajektom od Zadra. Katastarske čestice 2448/6, 2448/14, 2448/13 i 2449/1, izmjereno 7,02 hektara uz 1,11 km opsega.

fields.en: It carries old olive terraces in recoverable condition, dry stone walls, maquis, and a spreading cover of Aleppo pine. Most of the olives need pruning rather than replanting. There is no reliable surface water and no well.
fields.hr: Na njemu su stare maslinske terase u stanju iz kojeg se mogu vratiti, suhozidi, makija i sve gušći pokrov alepskog bora. Većini maslina treba rezidba, a ne nova sadnja. Nema pouzdane površinske vode ni bunara.
